name: Mini Egg & Cheese Breakfast Quesadillas with Mild Salsa (Kid-Friendly)

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, place eggs, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ tsp salt
1 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and scramble using a combination of stirring and flipping, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the pan. Cook until the eggs are no longer runny, then remove from heat.

Lay tortillas on a flat surface, then divide scrambled eggs and cheese between them, arranging on one half of each tortilla. Fold in half to close. (Wipe skillet clean with paper towels and reserve for the next step.)

Return the skillet to medium heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, place assembled quesadillas in the skillet and cook, flipping once, until cheese is melted and tortillas are golden on both sides, 2-3 minutes. Remove to a plate.
Divide quesadillas between plates and serve with salsa for dipping. Enjoy!
